note: Hand-measured local-loop milestones, quoted from merged PR bodies. Not collected automatically. Append a point to a series (or start a series) with a number you can cite: date = the PR's merge date, pr and commit = the merge commit, value in the series' unit, optional before (the same measurement before the change) and max (the upper end of a quoted range), what, and a one-line source. Never estimate or interpolate. tools/test_ci_history.py checks the shape.
